descriptions.description: Stauracanthus is a genus of flowering plants in the family Fabaceae. It belongs to the subfamily Faboideae. It is sometimes treated as part of the genera Genista or Ulex.

Stauracanthus comprises the following species: Stauracanthus boivinii (Webb) Samp. Stauracanthus genistoides (Brot.) Samp. subsp. aphyllus (Link)Rothm. subsp. genistoides (Brot.)Samp. subsp. vicentinus (Cout.)Rothm. Stauracanthus spectabilis Webb
The status of the following species is unresolved: Stauracanthus aphyllus Link Stauracanthus lusitanicus (L.) Cubas Stauracanthus nepa Samp. Stauracanthus spartioides Webb
